status: diagnostic localization, not an acceptance-threshold relaxation

layer5_pos0_ffn_input_q8_recalculation.method: CPU-only emulation of ReferenceModel::QuantizedInput: float32 divide, round half away from zero, float16 stored scale. These are recalculated bytes, not yet directly downloaded GPU quantizer bytes.

source_evidence.fact: HC down/up retain BF16; prefill Dense narrows activations to BF16 for hipBLASLt, while decode SmallGemm consumes float32 activations. Output head uses decode phase for both runs.
Float32 lane accumulation and wave reduction differ from CPU float64 accumulation order.
Decode reference explicitly reconstructs Q8 activation inputs then accumulates dequantized weights in float64.

limitations: Traces only cover positions 0 and 40, not all intervening recurrent states.
Initial CPU/GPU differences are consistent with reduction/nonlinearity rounding, but exact first primitive is not isolated by stage-level trace.
One observed quantization-bin crossing and route-set crossings localize discontinuous amplification, but do not by themselves prove every residual is benign.

layer5_local_replay.summary: Direct GPU Q8 bytes confirm the one-code boundary crossing. Same-input CPU/GPU local FFN error ~1e-7; forcing code4 removes 99.96% of local CPU/GPU L2 distance.
